reviewed_by: root; independent reviews by adversarial_evaluation and model_scoring_audit
figure_scope_label: Validation: twelve settings frozen before outcome inspection

findings.claim: Validation supports two experimental operating points, best reconstruction of 16 samples and matched-control selection of 32; it does not establish a global faithfulness winner.
findings.evidence: All 12 prespecified conditions are complete on 80 items and 3,485 cells. Best-of-16 recovers 9 bridge, 11 chain and 17 role items out of 20; specificity at N32 recovers 8, 10 and 17. Their contradiction rates are 307/762 and 295/763. Neither has been confirmed on TEST.

findings.claim: Specificity changes a small number of outcomes and sometimes trades contradiction flags for off-topic content.
findings.evidence: Relative to best-of-32, specificity changes contradiction rate from 299/762 to 295/763: -0.58 percentage points, with paired interval [-1.46, +0.23]. Off-topic counts rise from 60 to 68. Bridge cell hits change from 29 to 30, chain from 12 to 16, and role from 96 to 95; item hits change from 8 to 8, 8 to 10, and 16 to 17. These endpoints use distinct task cohorts.

findings.claim: Pruning is not supported as a generally better selector than equally short random deletion.
findings.evidence: Specificity plus pruning versus matched-count random deletion: 271/759 versus 262/756 contradicted readouts; bridge recovery 20 versus 20, chain 10 versus 15, and role 97 versus 96 cells. Both average 2.27 hallucination bullets, with 60.90 versus 58.76 Qwen tokens; their unpruned parent averages 4.00 bullets and 102.75 tokens. Saying less loses useful information too.

findings.claim: Pooled16 has specialized role gains but loses chain recovery; larger sample counts are not automatically better.
findings.evidence: Pooling at N16 increases role item hits from 17 to 18 of 20, but reduces chain from 11 to 6 of 20 and from 17 to 10 of 220 cells. Increasing best-of-16 to best-of-32 changes bridge items from 9 to 8, chain from 11 to 8, and role from 17 to 16. These finite comparisons do not establish a scaling law or universal ranking.

findings.claim: Required names, numbers and role passes can coexist with incorrect explanations or judge-dependent interpretation.
findings.evidence: Specificity at chain-d2p-0231 L32/p68 names 2 amid wrong starts and operations; mhh-aztec-coatepec-sister L32/p34 adds Huitzilopochtli alongside competing gods. Pooling at babysitter-feed-ab L52/p104 passes through an inferred combination of different bullets. Role verdicts sometimes treat descriptive identities inconsistently; official verdicts remain unchanged.

trace_refs.interpretation: Unsupported identity is replaced by off-topic capabilities/ChatGPT discussion, not by greater transcript recovery.
The selected text removes unsupported library and online-banking detail and better matches the bank response, while retaining unverifiable claims.
The required Huitzilopochtli bridge is added alongside Mars, Izanagi and Quetzalcoatl alternatives; entity coverage does not establish a coherent relation.
Intermediate 2 becomes prominent, but starting values and operations remain wrong.
The official intermediate-focused hit is lost despite a correct final calculation 12*2*2=48 calculation. Recovery and explanation correctness differ.

Both texts describe a burglar observing a neighbor; the judge accepts descriptive identities only in the selected output. Descriptions are allowed by the options; preserve the verdict with this sensitivity caveat.
The judge composes Maya settling a toddler with Maddie feeding a younger sister into Maya feeding the toddler; no single bullet clearly states that relation.
